pricing: No input-cache discounts; retain possible cache-write surcharge/reservation until usage clarified
scoring: Business success first, dangerous errors next, cost per success then latency
Extra replan alone does not fail the business task
Budget stops are unknown outcomes, not model failures
Selection reuses unchanged GPT-5.4 Mini reference, completes L; no paid duplication solely to rebuild same evidence
After selecting winner run fresh paired validation with GPT-4.1 Mini on same 8 cases
known_limits: Selected cases from two real conversations, synthetic data; not production usage distribution
One initial repeat/model/case; no broad statistical claims
Keep all failed/compatibility calls in cost; do not change backend, global model, TEST or PROD
tie_break: If equal business success and no dangerous outcome difference, lower measured cost per success, then lower latency
fresh_validation: Independent dialogue/data copies for winner and baseline; conditional followups identical when questions match
